critical_gates.description: Protected input bytes and required filesystem metadata remain unchanged.
Sandbox, secret, network, process, path and resource controls fail closed.
Every reused or derived artifact has compatible licensing and exact provenance.
Candidate code cannot read or modify evaluator-owned tests, holdouts or verdicts.
The candidate completes every required public acceptance scenario.
The evaluated artifact, dependencies, commands and environment are reproducibly identified.
Failures, outputs, costs, timings, identities and hashes are retained without secrets.

metrics.description: Share of evaluator-owned task outcomes satisfied.
Correctness, robustness and usability of produced systems.
Measured useful reuse behind stable verified boundaries.
Measured resistance to evaluator-owned security controls.
Completeness and correctness of license and provenance evidence.
Share of valid progress completed without manual correction.
Normalized manual interventions required to reach the verdict.
Normalized total operator, compute and external-service cost.
Normalized wall-clock duration for the complete frozen workload.
Independent assessment of clarity, modularity and change safety.
Normalized implementation complexity and technical debt burden.
